stops.note: a fortress or earthwork; the Siberian city of Kurgan is named after a large mound nearby
used for the thousands of ancient burial mounds scattered across the Ukrainian and Russian steppe
Marija Gimbutas's 1956 'Kurgan hypothesis' placed the early Indo-Europeans among the mound-builders of the Pontic steppe

current_meaning: a prehistoric burial mound of the Eurasian steppe
